After giving 50+ interviews, I have taken note of these top Data Engineering questions:


📌 Save this post for your next interview prep!

1. Explain design approach difference in database and data warehouse
2. What are different ways to optimize SQL queries
3. Compare transactional vs analytical processing systems (OLTP vs OLAP)
4. How to handle slow database queries
5. Why is Columnar Storage Faster for Analytics
6. How to architect an ETL pipeline for large, complex datasets with multiple sources and frequent updates
7. What are ways to handle incremental data processing
8. What is the purpose of normalization and what are its types
9. What are different types of indexing 
10. How to improve query performance

📘 Interviewers love to go deep on these areas — make sure you understand both the concepts and real-world applications.
